main.limits: Individual fresh cache-disabled completions with four frontend/codegen workers and a 30-second cap. Matched 5.588 to 5.555s is effectively unchanged latency, configured 5.551s. Five-second/subsecond and 1-2MB targets remain unmet.

microbenchmarks.method: Fresh cache-disabled single-worker processes; medians of 3 or 5 repetitions. Each retained source drives an independently checked checksum in both sync/async guests. Timing includes startup separately; total sweep elapsed includes generation, IO and execution. Small timing figures vary under shared-host load; byte hashes are deterministic. Both compilers are LLVM Fast.
microbenchmarks.limits: This fixes direct-argument traffic. Mutating owner-bearing result helpers still expand under the existing admission policy; packed controls retain the existing path. Microbenchmark percentage reductions do not predict whole-game savings. Earlier wider-source validation failures remain pinned in aggregate-scaling-2026-11-03.json.

implementation.input_demand: All local_get reads in the finished helper, including serialization, determine which original formal words arrive physically. Writes alone do not need incoming values; read-after-write stays conservative.
implementation.coordinates: A narrower private signature, i32 padding and descending entry copies preserve logical local IDs/types and original body suffix. The prefix shifts instruction indices; helpers with semantic/table position catalogs retain ordinary inputs. Hidden resource/table/provider operands and non-i32 inputs likewise retain ordinary inputs.
implementation.caller: All actual arguments and ordered owner events execute before physical masking. Logical result aliases reconstruct from full original arguments, including omitted input words. Unused result pointers can be omitted from signature; caller packet allocation and layouts stay unchanged.
implementation.rollback: Only unpublished helpers are transformed; FunctionMark owns changed function and appended signature on decline/OOM. Published counters roll back too.

transfers.note: Static nonoverlapping adjacent get/set or zero/set runs. These are not proofs of removability.

local_set_then_get_same_index.note: Overlaps transfer runs; replacing with tee depends on other IR metadata.

byte_accounting.note: Declared locals increase because preserved logical input coordinates become padding locals. Total size falls; static opcode counts do not measure runtime cost or prove removable work.
